label: Battle Moment
description: The story beat and its camera in one draw — items are tagged charge / last-stand / aftermath so template variants couple via tags_any.

items.name: lances-drop
items.text: the charge at full commit seen from a low chase camera racing beside the front rank, couched lances dropping level in a wave down the line, torn earth thrown man-high behind the hooves

items.name: closing-run
items.text: the last fifty paces framed head-on at helmet height, both lines breaking into a run, the gap closing, arrows still falling steeply into the space between

items.name: impact-ripple
items.text: the first heartbeat of impact seen side-on from just above the spear-points, the collision rippling down the line like a wave along a whip, riders standing up in their stirrups

items.name: shrinking-ring
items.text: a ring of shields shrinking around the planted standard, framed from outside the circle through the gap between two raised rims, every shield facing outward and none of them unmarked

items.name: broken-gate
items.text: a splintered gateway held by a handful, framed from inside the arch looking out at the mass pressing in, dust sifting from the strained lintel at every blow

items.name: hilltop-circle
items.text: the survivors back to back on the hilltop, camera low on the slope beneath them so their leveled spears rake across the storm-lit clouds, banners planted at the circle's center

items.name: crow-silence
items.text: the field after, seen from a slow high vantage — spears standing at angles like winter reeds, crows drifting down in ones and twos, nothing else moving

items.name: rain-on-steel
items.text: fine rain beading and running on abandoned helms and blades in the near foreground while the emptied field softens into mist behind them, banners soaked flat against the mud

items.name: survivor-walk
items.text: one unhorsed knight walking slowly out of the frame's depth between the fallen, helm carried loose in one hand, a wet banner cloth dragging from the other
